title: Flag raising speeches
summary: Flag raisings featured speeches by politicians but no dancing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well I was going to ask about the flag raising, did they have dancing there too? No, no. No dancing? No.

A lot of speeches you know. Have a regular big stand you know like the elections have and they get up and make speeches and that. Yeah that's what the politician is the rule. Even from all over would come in big crowds there. I thought maybe they'd turn into a dance then afterwards. No, not after that, they'd just have to play.
